svg.title: Set up dsh-baton in three steps
svg.desc: Step 1: run npx -y dsh-baton-mcp setup, which registers Claude Code and Codex and copies the plugin path. Step 2: in Harness open Plugins, Add plugin, paste, Install, Enable now. Step 3: in a new chat, ask for dsh_list_workspaces; it lists your Harness workspaces.
